operation.name: GetTypeOfGrievances
operation.query: SELECT [TypeOfGrievanceDetailID] ,[TypeOfGrievanceMainID] ,[Name] ,[Active] FROM [LK_TypeOfGrievanceDetail] where active = 1 and TypeOfGrievanceMainID = @TypeOfGrievanceMainID order by Name Asc
